text:
Priya Desai: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Posting the follow-up thread for review/promo/comp questions — drop Qs here and we'll answer. I'll consolidate and follow up with action items.

Jordan Kim: Quick q — when will final promo decisions be communicated? Is there a hard date?

Priya Desai: Good Q. Timeline: Managers submit calibration by Thu 4/30, Exec calibration Fri 5/8, decisions communicated week of 5/12 (subject to minor shifts). We'll post exact dates in the review doc: https://redwood.internal/people/review2026

Maya Chen: Are promo decisions retroactive to the start of the cycle or the communication date?

Priya Desai: Promotions are effective on the communication date. Retroactive pay is rare but only for approved exceptions — flag in the appeal form with justification and we'll review.

Liam O'Connor: For comp increases tied to promos, is there a standard % or band step?

Priya Desai: There's no single %, it's based on comp band midpoint and leveling guidance. Typical ranges are 8-18% depending on level and comp band position. Managers will get recommended comp adjustments during calibration.

Alex Rivera: If someone changes role mid-cycle (e.g., moves to product), do they get a separate review?

Priya Desai: If role change happened >6 weeks before review close, include them in their new role's packet. If later, use manager judgment; we can escalate ambiguous cases to People Ops.

Jordan Kim: How do appeals work? Timeline? What to include?

Priya Desai: Appeals open for two weeks after communication. Include concrete examples of impact, recent scope changes, and any missing context. Use the appeal form linked in the notification email. Appeals are reviewed by People Ops + lead.

Maya Chen: Will this cycle include leveling calibrations for IC vs EM differences?

Priya Desai: Yes — separate matrices for IC and EM. Please use the leveling rubric in the docs and ping People Ops if you need help mapping role scope.

hr-bot: :calendar: Event created: "Calibration sync" Thu 4/30 2pm-4pm (Zoom link in description)

Liam O'Connor: Any change to bonus eligibility this year?

Priya Desai: Bonus policy unchanged; eligibility criteria remain the same as last year. We'll communicate any policy changes if they occur.

Alex Rivera: For promo nom packets, is there a preferred template?

Priya Desai: Use the template here: https://redwood.internal/people/promo-template.md — include impact bullets, scope, and examples. Keep it concise (1-2 pages).

Jordan Kim: Can people ask for compensation benchmarking against market data?

Priya Desai: Yes — managers can request market comp analysis during calibration. We have updated market bands from CompData Q1 2026.

Maya Chen: Confidentiality question — who sees nomination packets?

Priya Desai: Only manager + skip-level + People Ops + calibration panel. Packets are treated as confidential.

Alex Rivera: If a manager misses the deadline, what happens?

Priya Desai: We'll send reminders. Late packets may delay decisions; escalate immediately to People Ops and your Director so we can triage.

Jordan Kim: Can we get a one-pager summary to share with ICs?

Priya Desai: Yes — will post a plain-language FAQ by EOD tomorrow and link it here.

Maya Chen: Thx!

Priya Desai: Thanks all — I'll post consolidated answers later and tag folks who asked for follow-ups. :sparkles:

Liam O'Connor: Appreciated.
